validated_report:
Utility-scale generation refers to electricity generation from power plants with at least one megawatt of total electricity generating capacity.
Small-scale solar PV systems are electricity generators with less than one megawatt of electricity generating capacity, not connected to a power plant with a combined capacity of one megawatt or larger.
